meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 让它审查已完成工作时,它会先收集目标、约束、变更文件等上下文,再并行派出 5 个后台子代理:分别核对目标与约束、审查代码质量、检查安全、实跑应用做 QA、挖掘遗漏上下文。5 个全部通过才判通过,否则给出各代理结论与问题清单。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前,或用户明确要求审查已完成工作时触发,例如说出“review work”“QA my work”“verify implementation”等指令。

say.text: review my work,提交 PR 前审查一遍
say.note: 启动 5 个并行子代理审查

say.text: QA my work,实际运行应用验证功能
say.note: 触发动手 QA 验证

say.text: verify implementation,对照原始需求核对

howto.what_en: Post-implementation review: gathers goal/constraints/diff/context, spawns 5 parallel sub-agents for goal check, code quality, security, hands-on QA, context mining. Passes only if all 5 pass; any fail fails the review.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work, e.g. saying 'review work', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', etc.

say_en.text: Review my work before I hand off the PR.
QA my work - run the app and verify it works.
Verify the implementation matches the original goal.
